limitations: خريطة مصدر ومخطط فارغ، وليست مسحًا لبيانات التشغيل.

روابط الاستيراد والمسارات تستخرج من التصريحات النصية الصريحة؛ التعبيرات الديناميكية غير محلولة. الإشارات الجدولية تحليل نصي قد يشمل تعليقًا أو فرعًا غير مستخدم، وليست تتبعًا تنفيذيًا أو دليل تغطية اختبار.
العلاقات المنطقية المحررة موضحة بوسم مستقل عن المفاتيح الأجنبية.
منح الدور افتراضية؛ لا تثبت صلاحية مستخدم فعلي أو سلامة تطبيق كل حارس.
الشاشات الفرعية الثابتة ضمن عقد المسارات؛ PAGES ليست كل شاشات المنتج.
المالية ملغاة؛ جداولها التاريخية لا تعني وجود شاشة مالية نشطة.

nodes.label: KI-109 · pmo/progress-policy
nodes.detail: Existing completed→100, partial-weight fallback and linear time-vs-progress thresholds remain policy assumptions. v5.78 adds evidence notices, not silent recalculation of existing project percentages.

nodes.label: KI-110 · org/target-period-plan
nodes.detail: Annual target editing is implemented; existing monthly plans are preserved with a warning but monthly/quarterly plan editing and effective-dated historical report snapshots are not implemented in this wave.

nodes.label: KI-112 · crm/cancellation
nodes.detail: Won reversal now refuses linked-project auto-deletion. A reviewed cancellation/unlink journey that preserves both records and reconciles sales is not yet implemented.

nodes.label: KI-001 · auth
nodes.detail: `must_change_pw` is stored and returned at login (`mustChangePassword`) and cleared by change-password, but **no middleware enforces it** — a user flagged to change their password keeps working forever; `seed-admin.js` writes 0. SECURITY-REPORT still lists it as an applied control.

nodes.label: KI-002 · web/XSS
nodes.detail: HTML helpers interpolate arguments **without `esc()`**: `statMini`, `noticeCard` (renders `e.message`), `pill`. Safe today because callers pass static/formatted values — latent XSS foot-gun the moment a caller passes user text.

nodes.label: KI-003 · ops/migrate
nodes.detail: `migrate.js` runs each `.sql` via `exec` with **no wrapping transaction**: on SQLite a mid-file failure leaves partial DDL applied with no `schema_migration` row → re-run collides with half-created objects. (PG multi-statement `exec` is implicitly atomic.)

nodes.label: KI-005 · ops/boot
nodes.detail: Boot takes ~2 min (sequential seed/backfill one-shots in `boot.sh`) against a 300 s Railway healthcheck timeout — each added boot step eats the margin; a slow boot = failed deploy.

nodes.label: KI-006 · http
nodes.detail: Body-size limits disagree: JSON body 1 mb, io upload raw 15 mb, bare-metal nginx path caps 12 m — a near-15 MB import upload would 413 behind the nginx deploy path.

nodes.label: KI-007 · tests
nodes.detail: `src/modules/search/*` (global search, Ctrl+K) has no dedicated tests — only two probes inside `tests/security/exec-surfaces.test.js:211-213`. Scope-inheritance claims are untested directly.

nodes.label: KI-008 · sql/portability
nodes.detail: Alias-less `FROM (subquery)` in `availableYears()` — legal on SQLite and PG ≥ 16 (staging runs PG 18), **error on PG < 16**. Latent portability trap; the convention "sub-SELECT in FROM needs an alias" is manual only.

nodes.label: KI-009 · seed
nodes.detail: `seed-roles` under demo-seed (`SANAD_SEED_DEMO=1`) writes accounts then crashes in `seedDemoOrg` — unlinks an employee not yet created (`unlinkUserFromEmployee`, org.js:496 → `employeeForLink` throws «الموظف غير موجود أو محذوف»), so demo departments/employees are skipped each boot. Staging unaffected (seed off there).

nodes.label: KI-010 · repo
nodes.detail: Repo bloat: `docs/evidence/` holds **128 MB** of screenshot packs in the working tree and git history — slow clones, near GitHub limits.

nodes.label: KI-011 · docs/changelog
nodes.detail: CHANGELOG version numbering collides: two `v3.9` (lines 358, 486), two `v4.0` (312, 336), no v4.1–v4.3, no v4.5 (v4.4→v4.6). Deploy markers are non-monotonic (v2.8–2.11 «بانتظار نشر», v3.8/v3.9 «لم تُنشَر بعد» below deployed versions) — "in CHANGELOG" ≠ "on staging".

nodes.label: KI-012 · tooling/docs
nodes.detail: Stale "17 demo personas" comment — `ROLES` actually lists 16 (matching 16 RBAC roles).

nodes.label: KI-031 · rbac/ops
nodes.detail: A prior staging audit found an orphaned retired finance role and grants. v5.76 excludes this role when loading runtime permissions, and identity writes already reject noncanonical roles. A restored/stale DB regression verifies the runtime guard. Live role/grant cleanup has not been performed or re-verified.

nodes.label: KI-032 · workflow
nodes.detail: `myApprovalQueue` filters `ar.sector_id = user.sector_id` for non-admins, so a **company-scope approver seeded with a `sector_id`** (e.g. `ceo_office`) never sees an escalation step routed to it from **another sector**. Latent today only because the role-based workflows are unwired (KI-033); becomes blocking the moment a submit path is added.

nodes.label: KI-033 · workflow/governance
nodes.detail: The five role-based approval workflows (opportunity/proposal/expense/deliverable/timesheet) are **dormant scaffolding**: `submitForApproval` has **no UI caller** (only raw `POST /api/approvals`), so the seeded amount-threshold escalation (`min_amount_halalas`, e.g. expense ≥ 2M SAR → CEO office) never runs on the path users use. Expenses are approved by a **direct status flip** gated only by `can(user,'approve','expense')` with no threshold. Only task approvals + staffing confirmations (the direct-settler rail) are actually wired. The reference doc (p22) presents the threshold path as the live mechanism. Proposals additionally have **no create/update route** at all despite tables+grants+workflow.

nodes.label: KI-035 · workflow/rbac
nodes.detail: **Residual after v5.12** (the invisible-approval half is fixed: every directed pending request now renders on «صفحتي» with inline approve/reject for any role, plus batched email — verified by `tests/integration/home-approvals.test.js` KI-035 regression). Remaining: (a) `department.manager_user_id` is still settable to any account with no role check, and the org-tree picker offers every active user; acceptable now that any assignee can act from home, but (b) **directed requests are not re-routed when `manager_user_id` changes** — the frozen `assignee_user_id` keeps the old manager as the only decider; and (c) no admin «معلَّقة بلا معتمِد» view.

nodes.label: KI-037 · notifications
nodes.detail: **Residual after v5.13** (the «صفحتي» card + batched email landed in v5.12; the bell now counts live pending approvals via `GET /api/approvals/pending-count` — self-clearing on decision — and links to the home card). Remaining: `notification` rows (task assigned, approval decided, …) still have **no reading surface** — the body is rendered nowhere and nothing calls `POST /api/notifications/:id/read`; they are a write-only record until a notifications list/page exists.

nodes.label: KI-053 · historical billing
nodes.detail: Historical invoice links/stamps still block deliverable deletion. The invoice UI and write APIs are retired, and no product workflow reconciles old cancelled/bad links.

nodes.label: KI-055 · pmo/finance
nodes.detail: **A billed deliverable stays fully mutable, so PMO and finance report contradictory billed numbers.** `patchRow` guards only delete + direct stamp writes; `amount_sar` on an `invoiced_at`-stamped deliverable is freely editable — PMO's invoiced/collected figures sum **current** deliverable amounts (`progress.js:99-100`, rendered `pmo.js:2084-2085`) while finance sums the frozen `invoice.amount_halalas` → edit 300k→500k and the two surfaces diverge with no audit link. A status rollback (ACCEPTED→REJECTED) also deletes the recognized `revenue_line` while the issued invoice stands. Verified 2026-08-18. **New writer in v5.32 (on `origin`, not yet in this working tree):** `attachRevenueLine` reprices a deliverable through `updateItem` and guards only on `amount_halalas > 0` — it never checks `invoiced_at`, so a deliverable already burned at 0 by an auto-claim (KI-054) passes the guard and gets a value while its ISSUED invoice line stays frozen at 0.

nodes.label: KI-059 · lifecycle
nodes.detail: **`remove.js` collection blocker is dead code**: the money guard lists `{ table: 'collection', col: 'project_id' }` but `collection` has never had `project_id` (001 DDL; 019 adds only net/vat) — `shapeOf` probes, misses, and `countLive` silently returns 0, the exact failure mode the file's own comment warns about. Today the invoice blocker incidentally shields collections, but it counts only `deleted_at IS NULL` invoices. 3 of the 4 money-blocker rows are untested. Reproduced 2026-08-18 (orphaned-collection scenario).

nodes.label: KI-060 · perf/finance
nodes.detail: **N+1 query storms in the finance aggregates**: `outstanding()` is one SELECT per invoice, and `financeSummary` awaits it in a loop, then `dso()` and `arAging()` each re-load and loop again — ~3N sequential queries per summary render for N open invoices in the year; `financeByContract` issues 2 queries per contract (≤200 contracts, concurrent but pool-capped at 10). Grows with open-invoice count exactly where billing history accumulates; each query is a network round-trip on live PG. Verified 2026-08-18.

nodes.label: KI-061 · finance/reads
nodes.detail: **Invoices with NULL `issue_date` vanish from every year at once**: `YEAR_PRED` (`finance.js:39`) is a CAST on `substr(issue_date,1,4)` with no NULL branch → the row fails the predicate for all years in invoiced totals AND AR/aging/DSO — a receivable that exists nowhere. `createProgressClaim` always sets the date, but `migrate-legacy.js:189` inserts `issue_date: deliveredAt \|\| null`; live rows depend on the one-off backfill having caught every case. Verified 2026-08-18.

nodes.label: KI-062 · finance/claims
nodes.detail: **Claim metadata edges**: (1) `contractDetail` orders invoices by `issue_date, claim_no` but `claim_no` is TEXT and unpadded — claim «10» sorts before «2» on a same-day tie (≥10 claims on one contract). (2) `invoice.progress_pct` is write-only (read nowhere), unclamped (>100 storable), and measured **project-wide** against one contract's value — structurally wrong on multi-contract projects. Verified 2026-08-18.

nodes.label: KI-063 · ui/copy
nodes.detail: **Arabic copy defects in the claim flow**: number agreement wrong for 1–10 («${n} مخرَجاً غير موجود», `finance.js:367-368`; «+ مستخلص من ${n} مخرج مسلّم», `views/finance.js:142`) — the platform's own `countAr` helper is unused here though used with مخرَج elsewhere (`attention.js`, `pmo.js`); unpriced deliverables print `fmtSar(null)` → «0 ر.س.» on the contract table (`views/finance.js:128`), violating «الصفر ليس غياباً»; claim issuance + collection use browser `prompt()` with OS-language buttons instead of the design-system modal, and `views/finance.js` still uses inline `onclick` (KI-013 class). Verified 2026-08-18.

nodes.label: KI-064 · finance/api
nodes.detail: **Silent truncation in finance listings**: `financeByContract` LIMIT 200, `financeByClient` LIMIT 40 — no offset/cursor, no truncated flag in the payload; contract #201 (lowest-value — where forgotten unbilled contracts live) never appears in the API response or any UI. Violates «الغياب ليس صفراً». Verified 2026-08-18.

nodes.label: KI-070 · ops/deploy
nodes.detail: `deploy.mjs` auto-discovery of the extracted PostgreSQL 18 client looks one level too shallow: it scans `/tmp/claude-*/<project>/scratchpad/pg18/…` but the real layout is `/tmp/claude-*/<project>/<session-id>/scratchpad/pg18/…`, so with no system `pg_dump` the mandatory backup step fails («pg_dump غير متاح») and the deploy aborts before deploying. Workaround used 2026-08-23: `PG_BIN=<…/pg18/extract/usr/lib/postgresql/18/bin>` (the script then derives `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` correctly).

nodes.label: KI-071 · web/foundation
nodes.detail: `src/web/public/styles.css` loads AFTER the inline design-system `<style>` and overrides it with contradictory rules (`body{line-height:1.55}` vs the system 1.7; a purple `::selection` vs brand blue). Effectively dead weight that fights the system.

nodes.label: KI-072 · web/perf
nodes.detail: Tailwind is shipped as the 407 KB CDN runtime (`src/web/public/tailwind.js`) on every page for ~90 class attributes total (mostly `govern.js`, `people.js`, `crm.js`); its config also declares `muted`/`faint` at different values than the CSS variables of the same names.

nodes.label: KI-073 · web/govern+finance
nodes.detail: **Unnamed per-row form controls let the browser restore a value onto the wrong row after `location.reload()`.** Controls with no `id`/`name`/`autocomplete` are restored **positionally** (Blink: one `name=""`+type deque consumed in document order; Gecko: a content-index state key), so any re-render that shifts row order slides the previous row's value onto its neighbour. Fixed on the tasks page in v5.40 (stable `id`/`name` per control + a load-time reconcile against `data-status`); **two instances remain**: (1) the project risk register — `views/pmo.js:2650` status select, server order `ORDER BY (status='CLOSED')` (`modules/pmo/governance.js:291`) with a reload at `public/pages/project-governance.js:58`, so closing a risk shifts every later select and all three share the same `OPEN`/`MITIGATING`/`CLOSED` domain (a slid value always matches a real option, so it is silently plausible); (2) the expense ledger — `views/pmo.js:1765,1777`, where settling an expense deletes its inline edit row (`editable = canEdit && !settled`) so the shift is count-driven. Not reproducible in the sandbox: headless Chromium under Playwright performs no form-state restoration at all (verified with an isolated probe), and no Gecko build is installed.

nodes.label: KI-074 · reports/session
nodes.detail: `sessionlessUser()` inserts a real `session` row per scheduled report **per recipient** just to build a scope, with a 60-second `expires_at` and the comment «cleaned by TTL» — nothing cleaned them until v5.42 added the hourly purge (10 such rows were live on staging on 2026-08-25). The purge now collects them, but the row should never be written: a user's scope is derivable without a session row, and a report run leaving login-shaped rows in the session table muddies both the admin session list and any future session forensics.

nodes.label: KI-077 · web/pmo
nodes.detail: **The author's pending-approval tasks vanish in board and calendar views.** `pendingMine` is stripped from `flat` (`pmo.js:507-511`) and re-inserted only inside `listBody` (`pmo.js:853`) — switch view and freshly-created pending work disappears without trace. Any fix brushes the v5.17/KI-041 owner ruling (the uncounted section excluded «من كل عدّاد ولوح وتقويم»); proposed reading: keep it uncounted but render the same section below all three views.

nodes.label: KI-078 · web/pmo
nodes.detail: **The DONE column silently shows only the last 14 days.** `doneSince = addDays(today,-14)` (`pmo.js:495` → SQL `src/modules/pmo/tasks.js:86`) truncates the board's «منجزة» column with no visible note — the count is neither the total nor an explained subset.

nodes.label: KI-079 · pmo/workflow
nodes.detail: **Live approval bypass: edits never re-evaluate approval.** `updateTask` (`src/modules/pmo/tasks.js:505-572`) never calls `taskApproval` — create an unlinked task (instant, no approval under today's rule) then PATCH `project_id` onto it: `assertMayLink` runs but no approval is raised and `approval_state` stays NULL. `bulkUpdateTasks` allows the same for up to 100 tasks per call (`tasks.js:489-503`). Bypasses the CURRENT conditional rule, not just the planned universal one.

nodes.label: KI-081 · web/pmo
nodes.detail: The four focus counters hardcode `view:'list'` in their hrefs (`pmo.js:741-744`), so clicking «متأخرة» from the board silently drops the user out of the board — although all four filters work in board and calendar.

nodes.label: KI-082 · web/pmo
nodes.detail: The `assignee` filter half-applies: it filters the list/board but not the person-card board above it (`teamWorkload` takes no assignee), so the page claims «تعرض مهام شخص واحد» (`pmo.js:1448`) while rendering every colleague's card (`pmo.js:954`).

nodes.label: KI-083 · web/pmo
nodes.detail: The «لاحقاً» link in the beyond-strip resolves to `win=all` (`pmo.js:864`) because `TASK_WINDOWS` has no `later` value (`pmo.js:432`) — the control does not do what its label says; `laterBand` is computed and rendered but unreachable as a window.

nodes.label: KI-084 · pmo
nodes.detail: **Orphan work is unreachable at department scope while the orphan strip points at it.** `teamTasks` requires `emp.department_id IN (…)` (`src/modules/pmo/tasks.js:441-447`), excluding unassigned/inactive-account tasks from the team list and board, yet the strip above instructs «أسنِدها من القائمة أدناه» and links to that very list (`pmo.js:1030-1031`) — an unfulfillable instruction.

nodes.label: KI-085 · web/pmo
nodes.detail: Active `flag`/`q` filters are invisible: `activeFilters` counts only status/priority/kind (`pmo.js:771`), so arriving via the «مُعطَّلة»/«بلا خطوة تالية» counters leaves the filter block collapsed with no badge, and the only «مسح المرشحات» control is buried inside it (`pmo.js:781`). `flag=noparent` is implemented in SQL (`tasks.js:72`) with no UI entry point anywhere.

nodes.label: KI-086 · web/crm
nodes.detail: **Classification chip counts lie under a year filter, and chips filter in memory over a capped read.** `solCount` is computed from pre-year `allRows` (`src/web/views/crm.js:312-315`) while the board renders post-year, post-filter `rows` (`crm.js:113-115`) — counts mismatch whenever a year chip is active. And the chip filter runs in memory over `listOpportunities`' `LIMIT 500` (`src/modules/crm/opportunities.js:87`) — beyond ~500 rows a chip can silently omit matches. The planned «مصدر المبادرة» chip (plan 04) copies both defects unless fixed with it.

nodes.label: KI-087 · ops/env
nodes.detail: **`.env.example` has no `SMTP_FALLBACK_*` block**, so the only written record of the fallback channel's variable names is `docs/guides/MAIL-CHANNELS.md`. An operator setting up a new environment from the template gets a platform with no mail fallback and no hint that one exists. Related: `.env.example:32` still ships `MAIL_FROM=Sanad Platform <no-reply@evc.com.sa>` — the exact domain `config.js` documents at length as **live and owned by someone else**, and the reason the code default was removed. Copying the template re-introduces it.

nodes.label: KI-088 · tooling/sweep
nodes.detail: **`scripts/sweep.mjs` carries a dead warning that makes the tool look less trustworthy than it is.** The 'QH-1 known-gap' note claims `/api/org/roster` serves raw `salary_halalas` to roles without the grant. That leak is **closed** — `src/modules/org/org.js:718` gates it behind `can(user,'read','salary')`, and `tests/security/permissions-matrix.test.js:152-178` asserts salary reaches admin only over real HTTP, in both the payload and the rendered page. The warning prints on every deploy sweep.

nodes.label: KI-089 · tooling/deploy
nodes.detail: **`scripts/deploy.mjs` step ٥/٧ cannot pass: the stamp it waits for never ships.** `d1ccb3d` (v5.58, committed 2026-08-28 18:25 — *after* that day's 18:15 deploy, so first exercised on 2026-08-29) writes `.build-id` into `platform/` and polls `/ready` for it, but `.build-id` is in `platform/.gitignore:22` and the upload honoured that, so the container reads `null`. On v5.59 the deployment (`a32835c0`) was **SUCCESS** with migration 039 applied and live assets byte-identical, yet the script reported failure and **skipped its own sweep and evidence steps** (run by hand). Until fixed, a red step ٥ after a green step ٤ means «verify by hand», not «roll back».

nodes.label: KI-093 · web/pmo
nodes.detail: **The deliverable «شهر الاستحقاق» list offers years the server refuses.** `dlvPeriodSel` builds its options from `dlvYears` — every year between the project's `start_date` and `end_date` (`src/web/views/pmo.js:2513-2521,2534`) — while the service caps the year at `2000 … currentYear+5` (`src/modules/pmo/governance.js:160-170`). Any project whose end date is more than five years out therefore renders dead options: picking one shows the red «سنة شهر الاستحقاق خارج المعقول — راجع السنة قبل الحفظ» and the select snaps back. The service comment «والقائمة على الشاشة محدودة أصلاً بسنوات المشروع» states exactly the assumption that fails. Reproduced 2026-09-02 on a local QA instance as `demo.sectorlead`: project «مشروع منصة تجربة الزائر» → «نظرة عامة» → تاريخ الانتهاء = 2040-12-31 → «حفظ التعديلات» → reload → the month list shows 2026‑2040 and 9 of its 15 years (2032‑2040) are unsaveable.

nodes.label: KI-094 · web/a11y
nodes.detail: **Seven visible form controls on the project page have no accessible name.** The shared `idField()` helper renders a `<label>` with no `for=` next to a control that has no `id` association and no `aria-label` (`src/web/views/pmo.js:2323-2325`), so the «نظرة عامة» panel's fields are announced nameless. axe-core on `/app/project/:id` as `demo.sectorlead` (1440 and 390): `label` **critical** ×4 (`#prj-name`, `#prj-value`, `#prj-start`, `#prj-end`) and `select-name` **critical** ×3 (`#prj-owner`, `#prj-dept`, `#prj-client`); all seven are visible on load (the section is open), not hidden-modal noise. Pre-existing, unrelated to v5.72/v5.73 — those two waves' own controls are axe-clean when scanned in isolation. Found 2026-09-02 (exploratory QA).

nodes.label: KI-095 · tooling/sweep
nodes.detail: **`scripts/sweep.mjs` reports 4 false deviations on every clean local boot.** `AI_CHAT_PROBES` was never extended when the two isolated CEO-Office roles landed (v5.61), so `office_coordinator`/`office_member` fall through to `default`: «ما المخاطر البارزة» expects 200 but the roles correctly get 403 (they hold no project/risk read grant), and «أنشئ مهمة متابعة العقد» expects 403 but they correctly get 200 (`task.create` is granted — `src/core/rbac/matrix.js:340-355`). The product is right and the expectation table is stale, yet the post-deploy gate a release is supposed to trust comes back red — the exact way a team learns to ignore a failing check. Invisible on staging only because those personas aren't seeded there (KI-028). Reproduced 2026-09-02: `node scripts/qa-up.mjs --scenarios` then `node scripts/sweep.mjs <base>` → «✗ 4 deviation(s)» with 18/18 roles otherwise green (0 leaks, 0 jargon).

nodes.label: KI-096 · web/govern
nodes.detail: **`/app/audit` prints raw English enums, machine timestamps and internal identifiers in «ماذا جرى».** `readDetail` renders any `detail_json` key missing from `DETAIL_KEY_AR` as its bare value (`src/web/views/govern.js:275-295,301`), and `status`/`rag`/`updated_at`/`updated_by` are all missing — so a project-status change reads «`ON_HOLD · 2026-09-02T13:33:16.067Z · u_PMd9FFh-WKH3`» instead of «الحالة: متوقّف مؤقتًا». Banned-jargon violation (CLAUDE.md rule 6) on an admin-visible screen, and **`scripts/sweep.mjs` flags it**: a clean local boot sweeps green, but after five status changes the same sweep returns «[jargon] demo.admin /app/audit — "ON_HOLD" visible» — i.e. the post-deploy release gate goes red the first time anyone uses the status control. Pre-existing (the header select could already write these rows), but v5.73 makes bulk status cleanup from the projects list the intended flow, so the frequency changes from rare to routine. Reproduced 2026-09-02 on a local QA instance: as `demo.sectorlead` change any project's status twice, then open `/app/audit` as `demo.admin` — 29 of the 200 listed rows showed raw enums.

nodes.label: KI-102 · historical revenue
nodes.detail: Migration 020 assigned undated imported deliverables to insertion periods and removed unlinked project revenue broadly. Runtime now requires evidence; old rows remain for reconciliation, not an automatic backfill.

nodes.label: KI-103 · historical VAT
nodes.detail: Old consulting workbook stores net amounts; some live deliverable amounts may have been treated as gross. Aggregate comparison suggests a second VAT deduction but does not prove every row.

nodes.label: KI-104 · demo identity
nodes.detail: Legacy unlinked demo employees without registry classification still require source reconciliation. v5.76 excludes registered demo employees from resource lists/direct profiles and assignee choices through either identity link. Similar names alone never establish demo identity.

nodes.label: KI-013 · web/security
nodes.detail: CSP ships **Report-Only**; enforcement blocked by inline `on*` handlers still in server-rendered HTML and `app.js` (49 attributes in `src/web/views`+`layout.js` — 34 onclick + drag/keydown/change; 26 in `src/web/public/app.js` — 22 onclick, e.g. app.js:370-378). New code already uses `data-action` delegation. The in-browser card reader's directives (`'wasm-unsafe-eval'` on `script-src` + `worker-src 'self'`, E2 of «الفعاليات», ADR-0014) are already in the header, so the enforcing flip will not silently break the events capture page.

nodes.label: KI-014 · web/security
nodes.detail: CSRF token enforced **only on urlencoded form posts** (`/auth/login-web` exempt); JSON API mutations rely on the `SameSite=Lax` session cookie as the residual defense.

nodes.label: KI-015 · rbac/pmo
nodes.detail: Projects still carry the list-vs-row scope contradiction: portfolio **list** is built sector-wide (department scope falls open to sector) while row-level read is department-checked. **v5.2 resolved the opportunity half the correct way** — lists narrowed via `deptCol` and the `SECTOR_WIDE_LISTS` row-widener removed — so the mechanism is proven; projects wait only on attribution (see KI-025/D15: narrowing today hides every dept-less project).

nodes.label: KI-016 · scale
nodes.detail: Single-replica assumptions: report scheduler is an in-process `setInterval`, rate limiter is an in-memory Map, mail account-allowlist is a per-process 60 s snapshot. At >1 replica: duplicate scheduled emails, per-replica limits, stale allowlists.

nodes.label: KI-017 · db/tls
nodes.detail: `PGSSL=require` sets `ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false }` — TLS without certificate verification (Railway-internal networking workaround).

nodes.label: KI-018 · server
nodes.detail: `unhandledRejection` logs and **continues** (process left running after an unknown-state rejection); `uncaughtException` exits. Deliberate: don't kill the server for a stray rejection.

nodes.label: KI-019 · server
nodes.detail: Graceful shutdown calls `server.close()` but never destroys idle keep-alive sockets — shutdown can stall until the 10 s force-exit timer fires. Bounded, so accepted.

nodes.label: KI-020 · docs/specs
nodes.detail: Specs 01/02/03/05/06 are **declared reference-only** with known divergences (e.g. `*_sar NUMERIC` vs implemented `*_halalas INTEGER`); spec 04-email-templates was never produced — templates live in `src/core/mail/templates.js`. On any conflict: code + ADRs win.

nodes.label: KI-097 · team/ai
nodes.detail: **The assistant's team tools are an in-app HTTP surface only; the remote MCP transport + OAuth/PKCE/audience validation for external clients (Claude Code / OpenAI) is unverified.** `GET/POST /api/ai/tools` runs the §13 tools under the session user and is tested (`tests/integration/ai-team-tools.test.js`), but no external client has authenticated or invoked a tool.

nodes.label: KI-098 · team/capacity
nodes.detail: **Allocation granularity is the month** (`allocation.monthly_json`): a split inside a month (kit T08/T09 — 50% first half + 50% second half, or 120% for part of a month) cannot be expressed; engagement start/end inside a month is day-prorated, capacity versions are day-dated, but a plan cannot change mid-month.

nodes.label: KI-099 · team/analysis
nodes.detail: **Per-person financial coverage is «غير متاحة»** on S17/S18 — there is no company-approved method to attribute contract revenue to individuals, so the column states that instead of a number.

nodes.label: KI-100 · team/close
nodes.detail: **No external finance integration**: the monthly close produces a locked snapshot + versioned CSV; the «حالة الترحيل للنظام المالي» is always «لم يُرحَّل».

nodes.label: KI-034 · rbac/expectation
nodes.detail: **إسحاق سيد opens «الفرص» and sees nothing, with no add button — by design, and it surprised him.** Verified live 2026-08-10 (read-only): his account `isaac.sayid@evc.sa` (`usr_P9AsLNqwXxwd`) is healthy — active, two-way linked to employee `u_ishaq_sayed` (إدارة الذكاء الاصطناعي والبيانات / SOLUTIONS); the old `u_ishaq_sayed` duplicate account was already soft-deleted 2026-08-01, so the v3.8 duplicate-pair issue is **not** the cause (an earlier version of this row assumed it was). Cause: his role is **استشاري (consultant)** — opportunity grants are read-own only, no create (`matrix.js:288-296`), and he owns 0 opportunities and has 0 opportunity staffings, so fail-closed scoping correctly yields an empty list and no add button. **Owner decision 2026-08-10: leave as-is** — استشاري seeing an empty «الفرص» is intended; if he later moves into BD work, revisit (role `bd_manager`, or staff him on opportunities via membership).

nodes.label: KI-021 · ops/backup
nodes.detail: Durable Postgres backups: `pg-backup.sh` dumps to container-local `data/backups/` (ephemeral — lost with the container). The Railway project now has a **Postgres-PITR bucket**, which partially addresses this; PITR coverage/retention is not yet confirmed and no offsite/restore drill has run against it.

nodes.label: KI-022 · docs/adr
nodes.detail: ADR-0003 says SQLite is the only supported driver and PG a later step — stale since Postgres went live on staging (dual driver in `src/core/db/index.js`, `DATABASE_URL` switch). Superseding **ADR-0004 is added in this same commit**.

nodes.label: KI-023 · docs/security
nodes.detail: SECURITY-REPORT.md lags implemented state (e.g. lists `must_change_pw` as an applied control though unenforced — KI-001; CSRF residual described stale vs `csrf.js`). **Being refreshed in this same commit.**

nodes.label: KI-024 · docs/readme
nodes.detail: README still describes the "vertical slice" era and understates current scope (21 pages / 16 roles / PG staging). **Being rewritten in this same commit.**

nodes.label: KI-025 · rbac (D15)
nodes.detail: Department scope in **project lists** deliberately fails open to sector: no project is department-attributed yet, so narrowing now would show department managers nothing («استبدال تسريبٍ بعُطل»). **The OPPORTUNITY half is DONE in v5.2 (2026-08-06, owner decision)**: attribution shipped in v5.1, then the visibility flip landed — bd_manager sees own opportunities, department managers see their departments' (primary + partner, read-only), `deptCol` narrowing is live and fails closed on empty sets (ADR-0005). **v5.5 (2026-08-08)**: after a real complaint from the tool owner, corrected the orphan case — opportunities with **no department** now list for department managers in their sector (matching the row-open behavior they already had), so the historical won portfolio (27 of 40 won opps are unattributed) is no longer invisible. Projects remain deferred until their own attribution; blocks KI-015.

nodes.label: KI-026 · org (D16)
nodes.detail: No effective-dating of org-structure changes — moving a department rewrites months of historic reports retroactively. Standard (Workday/SuccessFactors) is effective-dated changes; deferred as a separate wave after the structure stabilizes. Interim containment: audit log keeps every change with its date.

nodes.label: KI-027 · org (D17)
nodes.detail: Employees cannot see their own place in the org tree (tree view requires an admin-side grant) — «أين أنا ومن مديري» is hidden as a side effect, not a decision; `employee.line_manager_id` exists since 001 with no UI reading/writing it. One permission branch would open it.

nodes.label: KI-028 · ops/staging
nodes.detail: 9 of 16 demo role accounts can't log in on staging (`SANAD_SEED_DEMO=0` → seed skips them), so live sweeps exercise 7 roles; the other 9 are covered by `tests/security/permissions-matrix.test.js` only. Reactivating means demo accounts on a production-like environment.
